Styles for OGC services

Source: R/providers.R
ogc_styles.Rd

Styles for WMS GetMap and WMTS GetTile (KVP) endpoints, as 256 px tiles in EPSG:3857 (WMS through MapLibre's {bbox-epsg-3857} token). A RESTful WMTS template ({TileMatrix}/{TileRow}/{TileCol}) needs no builder: pass it as style. Python: basemapper.wms_style(), basemapper.wmts_style().

Usage

wms_style(
  url,
  layers,
  styles = "",
  version = "1.3.0",
  format = "image/png",
  transparent = FALSE,
  extra_params = NULL
)

wmts_style(
  url,
  layer,
  tilematrixset = "GoogleMapsCompatible",
  format = "image/png",
  style = "default",
  version = "1.0.0",
  extra_params = NULL
)

Arguments

url

Base service URL without query parameters.

layers

WMS LAYERS parameter.

styles

WMS STYLES parameter.

version

Service version (WMS 1.1.x sends SRS, 1.3.0 CRS).

format

Image MIME type.

transparent

Request transparent WMS images.

extra_params

Additional query parameters appended verbatim, or NULL.

layer

WMTS LAYER parameter.

tilematrixset

WMTS tile matrix set (a Web Mercator one).

style

WMTS STYLE parameter.

Value

A style JSON string.

Examples

style <- wms_style("https://example.com/wms", layers = "relief")
style <- wmts_style("https://example.com/wmts", layer = "imagery")
